notes: You need earlier BioPark experience. This is a second step after Nature Guides.
name: BioPark Education Student Volunteers
what_you_do: Teens help with classes, make teaching props and set up workshops. They also help at the zoo, aquarium or botanic garden for a semester.
who_can_apply: High school students 16 or older who worked as a BioPark Nature Guide or Camp Counselor in a past year. Background check required.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Staff can fill out an evaluation form if your school needs one (give two days notice).
duration: One semester. At least 6 hours a week between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m.
deadline_text: Applications taken all year. Placements usually made at the start of each semester.
how_to_apply: Call the Volunteer Coordinator at 505-768-3443 about openings. Then apply and pass a background check.
